output.reason: PMK 168/2023 replaces PMK 252/PMK.03/2008 and PMK 250/PMK.03/2008. It changes the PPh 21 calculation for permanent employees. Every tax period other than the last is now taxed at the monthly effective rate (TER) applied to monthly gross income. The last tax period is recalculated with the Pasal 17 rates on annual taxable income, rounded down to full thousands. The document also defines the components of gross income, including employer-paid JKK/JKM, health insurance contributions and insurance premiums. It sets the allowed deductions (biaya jabatan 5%, capped at Rp6,000,000 per year / Rp500,000 per month; pension/JHT contributions; zakat), the PTKP rules for female employees, and proration for partial tax years. It applies from 1 January 2024.
